one_line: Chaulukya (Solanki) king of Gujarat who, with the Kalachuris, opportunistically invaded Paramara Malwa soon after Bhoja’s death.

appearance.age_look: late 30s to early 40s, broad-shouldered, sturdy warrior-king build
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium-deep brown complexion, straight nose, neatly groomed full moustache with a short trimmed beard along the jawline, dark intense eyes under slightly arched brows; default expression is calm, calculating resolve with a hint of solemnity rather than triumph.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a high, neat topknot at the back of the crown, sides smoothly pulled back; he wears a simple conical gold crown-band (mukuta) with a single central red gemstone and a narrow cloth band of dark red wrapped beneath it, no extravagant spikes.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate mid-11th century western Indian royal attire: an ankle-length, cream-coloured cotton angarakha (wrap tunic) crossing right over left, tied with visible ties at the side; over this a rich dark-red silk patka-style sash wrapped firmly around the waist, knotted on the left hip with the embroidered end hanging to mid-thigh, bearing gold floral motifs; over his shoulders a muted indigo-blue cotton-silk uttariya (draped shawl) with a thin gold border, usually resting over the left shoulder and under the right arm; below, he wears straight, slightly tapered off-white cotton trousers gathered neatly at the ankles; on his upper body, a fitted bronze-coloured lamellar cuirass (small metal plates laced together) worn over the angarakha but leaving the full sleeves visible; arms adorned with simple gold armlets at the biceps and modest bangles at the wrists; feet in brown leather strapped sandals suitable for campaign; jewellery is restrained—small gold stud earrings, a single medium-thickness gold necklace, and no ostentatious gems, conveying a practical yet royal commander on campaign.
appearance.signature: A broad, slightly curved steel talwar with a plain disc pommel and simple cross-guard, sheathed in a dark-brown leather scabbard with subtle brass fittings, worn suspended from a dark-red cloth sword belt that passes across his right shoulder and down to the left hip.

ref_desc: Bhima I is a sturdy, medium-brown-complexioned warrior-king with a high black topknot, simple conical gold crown-band, cream angarakha, bronze lamellar cuirass, dark-red patka sash, indigo uttariya, off-white trousers, brown sandals, and a curved talwar in a dark-brown scabbard on a red shoulder belt.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Bhima I, the 11th-century Chaulukya king: a late-30s broad-shouldered man with medium-deep brown skin, an oval face, strong jaw, trimmed beard along the jawline and a full moustache, dark intense eyes, and a calm, calculating expression. His thick black hair is pulled into a high, neat topknot at the back of the crown, and he wears a simple conical gold crown-band with a single central red gemstone and a narrow dark-red cloth band beneath it. Dress him in a cream ankle-length cotton angarakha that wraps right over left, with full sleeves, over which sits a bronze-coloured lamellar cuirass of small laced metal plates. Wrap a rich dark-red silk patka-style sash tightly at his waist, knotted on his left hip with an embroidered gold floral end hanging to mid-thigh. Drape a muted indigo-blue cotton-silk uttariya with a thin gold border over his left shoulder and under his right arm. Show straight, slightly tapered off-white cotton trousers gathered at the ankles and brown leather strapped sandals. Add restrained royal jewellery: small gold stud earrings, a single medium-thickness gold necklace, simple gold armlets on his biceps and modest wrist bangles. His signature weapon is a broad, slightly curved steel talwar in a dark-brown leather scabbard with subtle brass fittings, hanging from a dark-red cloth sword belt that crosses from his right shoulder to his left hip. Use a palette dominated by cream, dark red, indigo blue, bronze, and dark brown, and present him front and back in consistent costume, hair, and weapon details.
